source_title: University Village Agrees To Be Acquired by Simon - PR Newswire
source_excerpt:
INDIANAPOLIS , Oct. 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Simon Â® , a real estate investment trust engaged in the ownership of premier shopping, dining, entertainment and mixed-use destinations, today announced that a Simon subsidiary has entered into an agreement to acquire University Village, an open-air retail center in Seattle, Washington.
Since opening in the 1950s, University Village has been a vibrant Seattle community hub. Over the decades, it has welcomed a diverse mix of owner-operated boutiques, businesses, and beloved local eateries, many of which have remained for years. Located north of downtown near the University of Washington, the open-air shopping and dining destination features more than 100 businesses and services. Widely regarded as a premier outdoor shopping center, it offers a curated mix of signature national brands, local boutiques, restaurants, and other businesses, including Apple, RH Gallery, Crate & Barrel, Room & Board, SÃ©zane, Lululemon, Aritzia, Vuori, and Din Tai Fung.
"More than thirty years ago, we set out to create more than a retail spaceâwe envisioned Seattle's finest neighborhood gathering place, where local and regional small businesses could thrive alongside quality national brands and families could come together. Looking back, we are deeply grateful. The Village began as an approximately 300,000-square-foot property, but it was never just about bricks and mortar; it was built around a vision of delivering an exceptional customer experience. Today, it has grown to nearly 600,000 square feet," said Susie Plummer, Partner and General Manager, University Village.
"University Village is an exceptional retail destination, and we are pleased to welcome it to our portfolio," said Eli Simon, Chief Executive Officer, President, and Chief Operating Officer of Simon Property Group. "This acquisition underscores our focus on owning distinctive, high-quality assets in strong markets. We look forward to building on the center's success for shoppers, retailers, and the greater Seattle community."
As the property transitions to new stewardship, University Village's owners extend their heartfelt thanks to the business partners, employees, and surrounding community who helped realize the vision of a high-quality shopping and dining destination. "We want to thank everyone who has contributed to University Village's success, past and present, throughout its nearly 70-year history," said Plummer.
The transaction is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2026, subject to the satisfaction of customary closing conditions.
